summary: Tested two production bug fixes: 1) SEO health-score endpoint (520/empty-response fix via try/except around asyncio.create_task), 2) Tasks summary endpoint shape validation. All 11 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: SEO health-score endpoint on cache miss returns a 'computing: true' placeholder with total_score=0 — the background task computes the real score asynchronously. This means the first call always returns 0/Calculating. Frontend must poll or re-fetch after a delay to get the real score. This is expected design but worth noting.

tasks/summary asyncio.create_task(_catchup_overdue_campaign_tasks) at line 336 is still called WITHOUT try/except, similar to the original SEO bug. If _catchup_overdue_campaign_tasks throws before entering its own try/except (e.g., an import error), the endpoint could return empty. Low risk since the function has internal error handling, but worth wrapping for consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes verified working: SEO health-score always returns valid JSON (cache hit, cache miss, invalid ID). Tasks summary returns 200 with total_today, completed_today, pending_today, overdue, progress_pct, activity fields. Valid user_id for testing: 69a0b7095fddcede09591667 (forest@imosapp.com).
